APPROVE authorizes a simulated payment. DECLINE cancels the order after reserved inventory is released. TIMEOUT reconciles uncertain payment before releasing inventory. DELAY produces a delayed result. No card details or real funds are used.

Unused items in original packaging may be requested for return within 30 calendar days of delivery.
This is a fictional policy for the CommerceFlow demo. The application does not implement return processing.
